parsed.title: Discussion on tax filing, domain purchase, app profitability, and potential scam

claims.text: Incorrect column markings in declarations can cause large penalties, requiring thorough checks of each column and numbers.
The tax calculator only works with a hryvnia‑based ФОП, forcing daily currency conversion for transactions.
The author had to resubmit declarations for all years, paying about 1000 ₴ instead of larger fines, due to a corrupt inspector.
No one is expected to buy the domain, and the domain has not been purchased yet.
Web platforms are less profitable than Android/iOS; SEO is poor, traffic sources are missing, and conversion is assumed near zero.
Successful rapid delivery (< 1 week) with a cross‑platform stack (Flutter) and copying popular ideas is suggested as a viable approach.
LinkedIn audience size for technical/managerial posts has dropped below 50%, affecting potential reach.
The project is described as a “free vibe‑code” with a single password stored locally as a 100 % discount promo code, suggesting no real value.
The app claims to fetch USD/UAH rates every 5 minutes and perform calculations locally, but the paid bundle allegedly contains nothing useful.
Participants label the author as a scammer and question the legitimacy of the product.

openQuestions.text: Is the source code accessible; can the password be found by searching?
